text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Within that "habitable zone," the 
"variable star" I seek resides—and 
overflows.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"...Severance confirmed, however. It seems 
this is the limit of the spectrum."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"...Neo Universe will go to meet you. 
Beyond 'entropy', far into the distance."
